name: boxaide
description: Your mailboxes as MCP tools — read, search, draft and send from Boxaide.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the Boxaide app running on this machine. Claude can then read and search mail across every connected mailbox, write drafts, and — only when you ask — send. It also gets the chat tools that hold a conversation inside the Boxaide window, plus the CRM, automation and outreach tools the live server lists.

Nothing to configure: the connector finds your local Boxaide server and its access token on its own. Install the Boxaide app first, from https://github.com/Remedy92/boxaide.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Where Boxaide is listening. Leave the default unless you changed BOXAIDE_PORT.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Leave empty. The connector reads the token from ~/.boxaide/bearer.token on its own; fill this only for a non-default data directory.

tools.name: chat_await_message
tools.description: Wait for the user in the Boxaide window
